title: Flint 1.0
summary: The first general release: Flint Friends and Flint capes inside Minecraft on every version, a redesigned Store page, a smaller and faster launcher, and fixes for the bugs players told us about.
points: Flint Friends inside Minecraft on every version, 1.8.9 included: chat, answer requests, pin friends and send gifts from the title screen, with a short note when a friend comes online or messages you
A Cosmetics window in Minecraft shows the Flint Store capes on your account and lets you wear them
Animated capes play on every version, 1.8.9 included, and in the launcher's previews
A calmer Cosmetics page: a 3D preview of what you wear, your items by slot with a clear None, and your Merit, orders and the Flint Store one click away
Add resource packs and shader packs while you play: they show up in Minecraft right away and can turn on at once, with no restart
Armor HUD: drag it anywhere in the HUD editor, change the size and weight of its durability text, and add your sword, pickaxe, axe, shield and other tools
Friends signs you in by itself with your Minecraft sign-in, safely: no codes to type, you stay signed in, and Friends opens straight away with your last list while it reconnects
With the Flint theme, the title screen's Friends button opens Flint Friends; the Vanilla theme keeps Minecraft's own
Your Flint cape shows first everywhere in the launcher, then your Minecraft cape
News opens the full article: Flint releases on flintclient.com, Minecraft releases on minecraft.net
Your friends show with their real skins, and a friend's name or message can never change how the game draws text
Type the memory a profile gets, such as 6 or 6.5 GB, instead of only dragging the slider
A smaller download: the Windows installer is about 30% smaller (15 MB instead of 22 MB)
New Minecraft versions install about a third faster (a fresh 26.3 install took 21 seconds instead of 31 on our test PC), and mods download several at once
On our test PC a new Flint profile ran 19% more frames per second than vanilla Minecraft on the same settings (822 against 690 FPS on average over 12 scenarios on 26.3 and 1.8.9)
3D Skins, Tier Tagger and chat stacking do far less work each frame, so busy lobbies stay smooth
"The authentication servers are currently not reachable" and "Failed to verify username" when joining a server: Flint waits a moment and tries again, on every version including 1.8.9
Toggle Sprint and Toggle Sneak no longer turn on by themselves after you close your inventory with the key held
Flint keys bound to a mouse side button work, and a mouse button let go inside a menu no longer stays held, so the camera and player never move by themselves
The Darkness effect from the Warden and sculk shriekers dims the screen again, as in Minecraft
Chat messages that start with "=", such as "=)", are sent as typed instead of being taken for a calculation
Elytra wings show again while you wear a Flint cape
A Flint menu that runs into an error closes instead of crashing the game
Two nametags over the same player on some servers: Flint follows the server's nametag rules, so every player has one
Flint players see each other's Flint icon again, including players a server keeps out of the player list
The sky no longer flickers with Custom Fog's No Fog or a high fog distance, and Blindness and Darkness always keep their fog

title: Friends
summary: Add your friends, see who's online and chat in Flint, now in 17 languages, plus profiles from other launchers, Update all and a calmer Music Player.
points: Friends: add Flint players by their Minecraft name, accept or decline requests, pin your favourites and chat. Only players who use Flint can be added
Set yourself Online, Busy, Away or Invisible, and get a note with a soft sound when a friend comes online, a request arrives or a message comes in (each can be turned off)
Flint asks before you send anything that looks like a password, email, login or card number, and keeps it blurred. Flint staff will never ask for them
Send a gift: the Flint Store opens with your friend already chosen as the one who receives it
Subtitles' Nearby Sound Activity shows sounds around you in the bottom-right corner, with arrows pointing where they come from, on every version including 1.8.9
Music Player: calmer motion, colours taken from the album art, a softer card while paused, and sliders for art size and bar thickness
Import profiles from the Modrinth App, CurseForge, Prism, MultiMC, Lunar, Feather, Dawn, the Minecraft Launcher, GDLauncher and ATLauncher, with their mods and settings
Update all: Flint finds mod updates by itself, and Update projects lets you choose versions, read changelogs and pin a mod
Flint in 17 languages: English, Español, Português (Brasil), Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Nederlands, Polski, Русский, Українська, Türkçe, हिन्दी, Bahasa Indonesia, Tiếng Việt, 日本語, 한국어 and 中文 (简体)
Syncing, Java and memory, Storage and Troubleshooting pages in Settings
Fixed: "The authentication servers are currently not reachable" on the first server you join, and the Brightness mod now works in single player and on servers, also with Sodium
Fewer crashes: every Minecraft version runs on the same Java, with the same settings, as the official Minecraft Launcher
Flint now also comes for Macs with an Intel chip and for Linux (AppImage and .deb)

title: Your profiles, your icons
summary: Your profiles in the sidebar with icons of their own, any tile color, UHC Overlay items as rows of their own, and a TNT timer that stays above the TNT.
points: Your profiles in the sidebar: open the arrow on the Profiles button to see up to five, pinned ones first, then the ones you play most
Give a profile a sidebar icon: over 100 Minecraft items in groups, with a search, on a tile of any color you pick, or your own picture
Pin up to five favorites from a profile's ••• menu, and right-click one in the sidebar to open or unpin it
Profile folders are named after your profiles, like Demon-26.3, instead of random letters and numbers
UHC Overlay: items you add show up in the Scale section, each with its own size slider and a remove button
TNT Timer stays in place above the TNT and gets smaller with distance, now on every version including 1.8.9, with a Time color
UHC Overlay's item search works from the title screen too, and a button that fails no longer turns off the Right Shift menu
The launcher stops showing Running the moment your game has closed, and Flint's news has a new picture

title: Any color, any item
summary: A full color picker for every color setting, UHC Overlay for any item, and the new Flint menu on every version.
points: Pick any color: a color square, a hue bar, your recent colors and a hex box, everywhere a mod has a color
UHC Overlay: search any item of your Minecraft version, add it and choose how big it shows on the ground
UHC Overlay now works on 1.8.9 too, and item lists show each item's picture
The new Right Shift menu, with up to 95 mods, on Minecraft 1.8.9, 1.21.1, 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2 and 26.3
Flint players see a Flint mark before each other's names and in the player list
Sign in to the Flint Store from the app to see your Merits and Store cosmetics
A smaller download and app: Flint now takes half the space it did

title: A cleaner right-click
summary: Right-clicking in Flint no longer opens the browser menu.
points: No more Back, Refresh, Save as and Print menu on right-click, anywhere in Flint
Copy and paste in text boxes with Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V

title: Flint on Windows
summary: The first Flint build for Windows, plus artwork for every version.
points: Flint Client now runs on Windows 10 and 11
Each Minecraft version has its own artwork in the version picker, Home and Profiles
Auto Sync saves settings correctly on Windows
Safer handling of file paths in Minecraft version data

title: Flint for Minecraft 26.3
summary: The first public Flint for Minecraft 26.3.
points: Quick Play: pin up to five servers from Multiplayer to the main menu
Flint updates itself: an Update button appears when a new version is out
A clearer Settings button
Flint's main menu stays readable at any GUI scale

title: Flint, now inside Minecraft
summary: Flint's own menu, now in Minecraft 26.3.
points: A Flint main menu inside Minecraft 26.3 with Fabric
Discord Rich Presence for games launched from Flint
Flint AI finds mods, resource packs and shaders in the Library
Memory can be set for each profile

title: A calmer, more complete Flint
summary: Home, Profiles and Skins rebuilt around real account and profile data.
points: Home, Profiles and Skins rebuilt around real account and profile data
Library talks to Modrinth with a live catalog, dependencies and a performance preset
Apple silicon marks 1.8.9 unsupported instead of failing mid-download
Safer RAM limits and a wired AI gateway with keyword fallback

title: A new Flint
summary: Guided first-run setup with Microsoft sign-in.
points: Guided first-run setup with Microsoft sign-in
Profiles with real Minecraft and Fabric installs
Mod suggestions checked against Modrinth
New Home, Settings and themes
